meta.title: Master Astrology Chart Types
meta.description: Unified, verbose reference for all major Western and Vedic astrology chart types, including relationship, forecasting, karmic, and Davison family charts. Interaction schema normalized across all objects.

interaction_schema_key.derived_from: Direct computational inputs used to produce this chart.
interaction_schema_key.feeds_into: Charts that take this chart as a primary input for further derivation or timing.
interaction_schema_key.overlays_with: Charts commonly combined, biwheeled, or read in tandem with this one.
interaction_schema_key.timing_with: Timing layers (transits, progressions, Solar Arc, returns, etc.) standardly applied to this base.
interaction_schema_key.supports: Charts this chart conceptually refines, validates, or adds nuance to.
interaction_schema_key.alternative_to: Charts that serve a functionally similar role via a different construction method.
